Entry-level and new-grad jobs

Fortune Jobs AI lists 597 open entry-level and new-grad jobs in the United States, updated November 27, 2026. 267 internship listings are shown separately and are not included in that job count. Matches use explicit junior, graduate and early-career titles or descriptions mentioning 0–2 years or no experience required. Check each original posting for requirements. This job portal is for every job seeker; all experience levels remain available.

Updated November 27, 2026

How to use this search

864 listings from 326 distinct advertised company names across 51 states are represented in this snapshot. Company names are counted as listed, not as a verified ownership group.

Explicit mentions in this page’s available listing text: Python (26), testing (24), AWS (18). These are text mentions, not a complete skill survey.

A junior or graduate title is a starting point. Read the original requirements and highlight only relevant coursework, projects and experience you can verify. Internship listings are labelled separately.

Frequently asked questions

How many entry-level and new-grad jobs are open in the United States?

Fortune Jobs AI lists 597 open entry-level and new-grad jobs in the United States as of November 27, 2026.

How much do entry-level and new-grad jobs in the United States pay?

The 25th–75th percentile of listed salary midpoints is $81,425–$112,000 a year, based on 135 listings where employers list pay. Listings without usable pay data are excluded; hourly and yearly pay are not mixed.

Which employers are hiring for entry-level and new-grad jobs in the United States?

Employers in this catalogue include PwC (48 listings), SynergisticIT (46 listings), SalesDraft Recruiting (39 listings), Cengage Group (34 listings), and Cadmus (33 listings).

Do any entry-level and new-grad jobs in the United States mention visa sponsorship or OPT?

1 listing mentions visa sponsorship or OPT/CPT. A mention does not guarantee sponsorship or eligibility; confirm with the employer.

Do I need experience?

2 listings mention 0–2 years and 0 say no experience required. Other requirements vary; review the original posting. A title match alone does not confirm eligibility.
